title: Coombs test and blood type in newborns
what: Your newborn's blood type and Rh factor are checked, and the test looks for the mother's antibodies on the baby's red blood cells. These antibodies can break down the baby's blood.
why: If the mother has Rh-negative blood or blood type O, or if the baby gets jaundice or anemia early.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come within a day
tell_doctor: The mother's blood type and Rh factor
If antibodies were found in the mother during pregnancy
If the mother had an anti-D (Rh) immunoglobulin shot
If older children had jaundice after birth

prepare.title: Preparation
prepare.text: None needed. Feed your baby as usual.

prepare.title: How it is taken
prepare.text: Blood is often taken from the umbilical cord right after birth. Sometimes from the baby's heel or a vein.

prepare.title: Documents
prepare.text: Keep your pregnancy record card and the mother's test results at hand.

bring: The mother's blood type and antibody results
steps: If the sample is from the cord, it is taken right after birth. It does not hurt the baby
If it is from the heel, the heel is warmed and wiped with antiseptic
A tiny prick is made, and a few drops are collected
A cotton pad is pressed on the spot
The blood is sent to the lab
feel: From the cord, the baby feels nothing
From the heel or a vein, the baby cries briefly. Holding them close or feeding helps
after: Results usually come within a day
If the test is positive, the doctor checks bilirubin more often and watches for jaundice
Sometimes the baby needs light therapy. The doctor will explain
red_flags: Jaundice is getting worse, and the skin is yellow down to the belly and legs: see a doctor right away
The baby is floppy, feeds poorly, or is hard to wake: call emergency services

faq.q: Is a positive Coombs test dangerous?
faq.a: It means the mother's antibodies are on the baby's blood. Often it passes with monitoring. The doctor keeps an eye on bilirubin.
Usually, yes. Frequent feeding helps the baby clear bilirubin faster. Ask your doctor.

reminders.text: Before the birth, pack your pregnancy record card and your blood type and antibody results in your bag.
